name: SiriusPoint Ltd.
summary: SiriusPoint Ltd. provides multi-line reinsurance and insurance products and services worldwide. It operates through four segments: Global P&C Programs, Global Reinsurance, Global Accident & Health, and London Market Specialty. The Global P&C Programs segment offers programs space to clients and distribution partners. The Global Reinsurance segment provides casualty, property, and other specialties, such as proportional and excess of loss, treaty and facultative, aviation and space, marine and energy, and credit to insurance and reinsurance companies, government entities, and other risk bearing vehicles.
